title: House and Room
author: Kestrel Iversen
blurb: Quentin Galloway, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
